transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Well... I suppose I'm here because of what's been happening at the house. It's... it's been nearly two years now. I'm sure the contractor and some of the people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us. They're keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. 

My husband keeps showing me receipts, and they give all these excuses, but... none of that matters. I know what's going on. That's... really all there is to it.
Besides these thoughts about the contractor and your neighbors, have you heard voices or seen things that other people around you haven't noticed?
No... no, nothing like that. I don't hear voices. Just... what I already told you.
Besides what's happening with the contractor and your neighbors, are there other situations or people that you believe are working against you or trying to harm you in some way?
No... just the house. I don't really have trouble with anyone else. It's... just what I already told you.
Can you walk me through exactly how you think the contractor and your neighbors are coordinating together to keep your kitchen wrong on purpose? What is their plan or reason for doing this?

I... I couldn't tell you exactly why they're doing it. I don't know their reasons. I just know that they are. 

You can see them out there, talking on the street. And then... the work just stays wrong. I don't know what the grand plan is supposed to be. I just know what's happening in my own house. You'd really have to ask them why.

Besides the kitchen and the contractor, do you have concerns that other people in general—people you don't know well, or even strangers—might be watching you or trying to interfere with your life in other ways?

No. I... no. Why would strangers be watching me? I mostly just keep to myself. 

It's really just... what's going on at the house. Like I've been saying. I don't have problems with anyone else.

Over these past two years, besides the kitchen situation, have there been times when you felt like people were talking about you behind your back or that something was being done to harm or control you in other ways—at work, with family, or anywhere else in your life?
No. I already told you... it's just the house. I don't work anymore, so there's no one at work. My family... they're fine. It's just the kitchen. That's all.
When you look at the kitchen work that's wrong, can you describe in detail what specifically they did wrong and how you know it was done on purpose rather than just being a mistake?

I don't really want to go through every single cabinet and tile. It's just... it's half-wrong. Always. 

For nearly two years now, it's been like this. They always have excuses for why it looks the way it does. My husband... he keeps showing me receipts, trying to say they bought the right things or that it's just normal mistakes. But I know what I see. 

I'm just sure that the contractor and some of those people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us. They're keeping it wrong on purpose, no matter how many receipts my husband pulls out or what stories they tell him. You just... you can tell when something isn't an accident.

When you think about the contractor and your neighbors working together on this, do you believe they are doing this specifically to cheat you out of money, or do you think there's something more—like they're trying to harm you personally or prove something about you?

I... I don't know about all that. Harming me personally? No. 

It's just the money. They're just dragging it out to get more money out of us. That's what people do. I don't... I don't think it's deeper than that. They just want to cheat us.

When you think about the contractor and your neighbors working together, do you see this as part of a larger pattern—like there are other groups of people in different areas also doing similar things, or is it really just isolated to your house and this particular contractor?
No... just my house. I don't know anything about other people or... larger patterns. I just know what they're doing to my kitchen. That's it.

If your husband or someone you trust showed you clear evidence that the kitchen work was actually done correctly and that there were no mistakes, do you think you could believe them, or are you completely certain that what you're seeing is intentional wrongdoing no matter what evidence they presented?

I... I don't know what kind of evidence that would be. Like I said, my husband already shows me receipts and things. 

It doesn't change what I see. For nearly two years, I've known they're working together to cheat us. The people on the block, the contractor... they keep it half-wrong on purpose. I don't need evidence to know what they're doing. I just know.

If I told you that I believed the kitchen work was done correctly and there were no mistakes, would you think I was wrong, or would you consider that maybe you might be mistaken about what's happening?

I... I think you'd be wrong. 

You haven't been there. You haven't seen it for the last two years. I've told you... I know they're working together. The contractor, the neighbors. They're keeping it half-wrong on purpose to cheat us. 

It doesn't matter what you think, or what excuses they give, or what receipts my husband has. I'm not mistaken. I just know what's happening.

When you think about how the contractor and your neighbors are coordinating to keep your kitchen wrong on purpose, do you have a clear understanding of how they communicate with each other, what signals or methods they use to coordinate their actions, and how they decided to target your house specifically?

I... I don't really know about all that. How they talk to each other, or... signals. I don't watch them out the window or anything. 

I just see the kitchen. 

And I couldn't tell you why they picked my house. I don't know why. They just did. I don't have all those answers for you, I just know what they're doing.

On a scale where 1 means you're not sure at all and 10 means you're completely certain with no doubt whatsoever, how certain are you that the contractor and your neighbors are deliberately keeping your kitchen wrong on purpose to cheat you?

I... a 10. 

I've told you. For nearly two years, I've been sure they're working together to cheat us. The contractor and the people on the block. They keep it half-wrong on purpose. 

My husband shows me receipts, they give excuses... it doesn't matter. I'm sure of it.
